## Fixed (Rich typing)

- Deleting everything inside a mark left an empty pair behind (`**`), which then read as the start of bold: type again and you got `**he**` instead of `*he*`. The empty pair now goes, and typing there comes back in the same mark.
- Deleting one side of a mark left the other behind (`hi*`). Now both sides go together, for actions, bold and speech.
- Typing a `*` or `"` yourself, or pasting text that already has marks, got wrapped in your default mark (a typed `*` became `***`). Your own marks are left as you type them.
- Typing the closing `*` at the end of an action added a third star. It now steps over the closing mark.
- Emptying a bold inside an action brought your next words back as plain action. They come back bold.
- Some keyboards (Gboard among them) send a backspace twice, and the second, out-of-date copy put the marks you'd just deleted back. Butler now ignores that repeat. This was the main cause of the stray `**`.
- The " key over the message box now gives ' inside an action too, not only inside speech, so you can quote inside an action. Tap it again to step out of the quote.

## Install

Grab **Butler-0.2.2.apk** below. It installs over any earlier version and keeps your chats and settings.
